_comment: B6.1. The divergences the historical replay is allowed to find.
EMPTY IS THE HONEST STARTING STATE, not an oversight. Every entry has to name
a real issue by publicId and list the exact uids that diverge, and those come
from running the replay against an environment that holds both the imported
issues and the message estate. Guessing them from the analysis would produce a
manifest that agrees with the replay by luck or, more likely, silently permits
the wrong uids on the right issue.
Populate it from GET /rest/publication-series/replay against the test
environment, one entry per diverging issue, each naming its DivergenceClass
and a reason a person wrote. An entry with a blank reason, an unknown class,
or an empty delta is refused at load. An entry that no longer diverges fails
the build, so this cannot rot into a blanket suppression.
Until it is populated the gate is at its strictest: ANY divergence fails.
That is the correct default -- it errs towards telling somebody.
